pages.title: Cards VS Gravity Pro
pages.description: Master gravity-defying tricks with Cards VS Gravity Pro. A high-energy stunt game for ages 8+ available at Cogs Toys & Games Ireland. Solo or group play!
pages.ld_description:
Cards VS Gravity Pro


Suitable for ages 8 and up, designed for solo play or friendly challenges with others.


High-energy stunt game where you flip, flick, and stack cards in mid-air to complete gravity-defying tricks. 🌀


Includes 80 precision-engineered cards, a trick guide, and practice missions to help players master their skills step by step.


Encourages hand-eye coordination, dexterity, and creative problem-solving as players learn new stunts.


Open-ended playtime — perfect for quick practice rounds or extended trick sessions.


Great for solo mastery or showing off your best stunts at parties, game nights, or talent challenges.


Compact and portable, easy to take anywhere for on-the-go fun.


Defy gravity and take your skills to the next level! Whether you’re perfecting tricks alone or impressing friends, Cards VS Gravity Pro delivers nonstop action and skill-building fun. 🃏
